title: IT Foods Industries
description:
Manufacturing

I.T. Foods Industries Co., Ltd. is a Thai manufacturer and exporter specializing in high-quality frozen foods, including frozen fruits, vegetables, fishery products, and value-added items. Established in 1990, the company adheres to international quality standards such as ISO 22000:2018 and GMP, ensuring food safety and quality. Their target clients include global markets seeking ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat products. With a commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction, I.T. Foods aims to enhance the quality of life through their diverse frozen food offerings.
https://www.itfoods.co.th
